dct_description_sm: Conductivity, temperature, and pressure were measured by a Glider Payload CTD (SBE GPCTD, Seabird). Oxygen frequency was measured by an oxygen optode (SBE 43F DO, Seabird). Both instruments were mounted in the sensor skid of a remotely operated vehicle (ROV) during the ARTofMELT2023 expedition in May and June 2023. Data use manufacturer calibration. The Gibbs SeaWater (GSW) Oceanographic Toolbox of TEOS-10 was used to derive other hydrographic data. The conversion from oxygen frequency to dissolved oxygen concentration was performed using the OOI L2 data product DOCONCF (Vardaro, 2014).
dct_subject_sm: Calculated, using OOI L2 data product DOCONCF
Atmospheric rivers and the onset of sea ice melt 2023 (ARTofMELT)
dct_title_s: Hydrographic data from ROV survey ARTofMELT2023/1_20-3 on 2023-05-20, survey 2
